project_type: Laravel 12 web app with Filament 5 admin panel and Laravel Breeze auth; Blade + Tailwind (CDN) frontend; boarding-house (kost) rental domain.
build_system: Composer (PHP deps) + npm/Vite (frontend assets). No separate compile step for PHP. Filament/Livewire auto-discovered.
test_framework: PHPUnit 11 (tests/Feature, tests/Unit). Tests run on sqlite :memory: via phpunit.xml env (APP_ENV=testing, DB_CONNECTION=sqlite). The pgsql-only CHECK-constraint migrations self-skip on sqlite.
build_command: composer install (deps already installed; no build needed for PHP changes)
verification_instructions: 1) php artisan test  (whole suite green). 2) php artisan migrate:fresh --seed  (seeders complete). 3) Manual: owner@arca.com / password logs into /admin; a seeded customer (e.g. alvin@gmail.com / password) logs into /dashboard. Clear config cache with 'php artisan config:clear' after editing config/.env.
environment_constraints: DB is PostgreSQL (DB_CONNECTION=pgsql, database arca_kost, user anantatusan, empty password) in .env — DO NOT change any DB_* keys. Tests use sqlite :memory:. No queue/mail dependencies needed. Dev server (if started) is via 'composer dev' / 'php artisan serve'.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md or .kiro/steering present. Follow existing conventions: thin controllers; models use $guarded = [] (Booking, Room, Payment) or $fillable (User); Blade views under resources/views; Filament 5 resource structure. Keep Midtrans out of the required path. Keep changes scoped to registration fix + manual payment + owner verification; do not refactor unrelated code.
key_patterns: Breeze auth in routes/auth.php (required by routes/web.php). Login+register share resources/views/auth/login-page.blade.php via a $mode var; the form action defaults to /login and is swapped to /register by JS (toggleAuth) — a fragility to harden. Customer booking/payment routes are behind middleware ['auth','verified'] in routes/web.php; User does NOT implement MustVerifyEmail so 'verified' passes. Filament 5 actions use Filament\Actions\Action / Filament\Actions\EditAction and notifications use Filament\Notifications\Notification (see ServiceRequestResource.php). Booking::booted() has a 'deleted' hook that frees the room. Room status strings: 'available' / 'occupied'. Booking status CHECK constraint (pgsql, migrations 2026_05_20_085218 + 2026_06_15_000002) allows ONLY: pending, review, active, cancelled, completed — reuse 'review' for awaiting-verification and 'pending' for rejected; do NOT introduce a new status.
directory_structure: app/Http/Controllers (incl. Auth/), app/Models, app/Filament/Resources/<Resource>/{Resource.php, Pages, Schemas, Tables} — NOTE: BookingResource.php defines form()/table() INLINE and does NOT use its Tables/BookingsTable.php or Schemas/BookingForm.php stubs, so edit BookingResource.php directly. resources/views/{auth,booking,pages}, database/{migrations,seeders,factories}, config/, routes/{web.php,auth.php}, tests/Feature.

verification_findings.registration: DB users.role has default 'customer' and is NOT nullable (verified via information_schema). RegisteredUserController@store currently omits role but DB default fills it; simulated store produced role='customer' and redirect to /dashboard. The existing tests/Feature/Auth/RegistrationTest.php passes. Fix is to make role explicit + a model default + harden the shared form, not to chase a null that the current schema prevents.
verification_findings.midtrans: No Midtrans\ import or Snap call anywhere in app/. midtrans/midtrans-php stays installed but unused. BookingController@pay hardcodes dummy bank details + a QR via simple-qrcode; processCheckout already does manual bank-transfer + proof upload and sets status 'review'. Part B is a rework, not a removal.
verification_findings.payments_table: payments table is empty (0 rows); columns: id, booking_id, amount, payment_method, status enum(pending|success|failed), snap_token, timestamps. Add nullable verified_at + notes via one migration. No Payment rows are created anywhere currently.
verification_findings.bookings_columns: bookings has proof_of_payment (reuse) and NO payment_method column.
